summary: Iteration 16: Verified staff-permission fix + CPIS stock/difference additions on the To-Order page. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed. Frontend: staff can add products (no 'Admin access required' error), pack list shows 'in stock N', row shows CPIS stock/Physical stock/Difference (green +, red -), physical stock persists across reload, staff cannot see mark-ordered/delete/checkbox controls, admin regression OK (add + mark-ordered + delete + bulk controls visible). Cleanup complete – page ends empty.
critical_code_review_comments: OrderListPage.js is ~514 lines with search dialog, mark-ordered dialog, table, and persistStock all mixed – would benefit from splitting into sub-components (ProductPickerDialog, MarkOrderedDialog, OrderRow) for readability and testability.
server.py is 1478 lines – consider splitting into routers (auth, cpis, order_list, purchase_orders, receivals, pricing).
GET /order-list, POST /order-list, PUT /order-list/{id} are all open to any authenticated user; document explicitly that staff can edit ANY row's physicalStock (currently intended, but worth a note).
seed_data_creation: Created 1 staff-added row (STRAW MUSHROOMS HALVES, ambori14) with physicalStock=33 during flow; deleted via admin cleanup. Ended with 0 items.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To-Order + CPIS staff-access flow fully validated. All prior iteration_15 features still work (add, mark-ordered single & bulk with ETA, delete). Pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_order_list_staff.py is safe to re-run (self-cleans). Note: CPIS upstream sometimes returns transient 502 via CDN – retry once if seen.
rca of the issue: Root cause of prior bug: /api/cpis/products, /packs, /stock used Depends(require_admin) causing 403 for staff tokens. Fix (verified): switched to Depends(get_current_user); OrderListItemInput now accepts cpisStock; POST/PUT compute stockDifference = physicalStock - cpisStock. mark-ordered + DELETE remain admin-only.
